results.optimization: Fix tile size mismatch - use RDNA2 values instead of AMPERE
results.notes: Fixed bug where kernel hardcoded AMPERE values but dispatch selected based on compute_capability. For q5_0/q5_1/q8_0/q6_K this caused swapped mmq_x/mmq_y (128x64 vs 64x128). Now uses RDNA2 values as default for Intel Xe2. 726/726 tests passed.

XMX/joint_matrix implementation blocked by Intel oneAPI 2025.1 API change - experimental::matrix moved and unavailable. XMX infrastructure present in code but disabled. Build succeeds, 726/726 tests pass.
